rng_policy: Batch size 1; before each independent generate call, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all use int(sha256(f'20260924:{row_id}')[:8],16) % (2**31-1). The budget is excluded from the seed. This new row RNG strategy does not require agreement with the historical batch-eight generation prefixes. Cross-budget prefix equality is measured rather than assumed.
parser: Frozen final-line parser applied only AFTER an observed generated </think> token boundary; missing/ambiguous boundary is INVALID
independence: Every budget runs generate from the original prompt; no generated-prefix reuse
inference_boundary: Ten equal-hop diagnostic items estimate completion/memory/runtime, not population accuracy
